title: First-order approximations of multifunctions defined implicitly by "split" feasibility problems with applications to optimization
summary: In the present paper, a study is made of first-order differential properties of certain multifunctions, which are defined as a solution map associated with a family of parameterized ``split" feasibility problems. The latter are a class of convex feasibility problems, whose specific structure makes them suitable for well-established applications in several areas of engineering and systems biology.
